MINUTES OF AN ADJOURNED SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD
ON MONDAY, JUNE 22, 2020, 5:00 P.M., IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBER AT CERRITOS
CITY HALL, 18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA

This meeting was adjourned from the Monday, June 8, 2020, 7:00 p.m. City
Council/Successor Agency Meeting for the purpose of continuing Closed Session Items 12A,
12B, and 12C only as listed on the agenda. No additional items were added and, pursuant to
California State law, the public was provided an opportunity to comment on the Closed
Session items at the June 8, 2020 meeting. Meeting materials and an on-demand recording of
the June 8, 2020 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Meeting can be accessed at
www.cerritos.us. The Closed Session report was given at the Thursday, June 25, 2020, 7:00
p.m. City Council/Successor Agency regular meeting.

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 5:00 p.m.

2.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Bruce Barrows
  Council/Agency Member Grace Hu
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Chuong Vo
  Mayor/Chair Naresh Solanki

3.  Closed Session Item 12 continued from  the  June  8,  2020  City
  Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting

  City Attorney Mark Steres announced the City Council would recess to Closed
  Session to continue discussion of Closed Session Items 12A, 12B, and 12C as listed
  on the agenda.

  12A.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Manager

  12B.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Attorney

  12C.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Clerk/Treasurer

4.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 9:45 p.m. The Closed Session report for this item will
  be announced at the June 25, 2020 City Council/Successor Agency regular
  meeting.
